notes.title: One week left till the release of House of Jigsaw: Masters of Art
notes.notes:
We're beyond excited to announce the upcoming launch of our new game [b]House of Jigsaw: Masters of Art[/b]! 

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39580520/994fbf343b8dbcf5354b0dbc1f6c583701b3b2da.jpg[/img]

Be among the first to experience [b]all major art styles[/b] in more than [b]100[/b] high quality puzzles. Enjoy the modern UI and 4 difficulty levels (30/120/300/600 pieces) in just one week. 

Get ready to jump into the puzzles in a world of stunning visuals. Can't wait to see you then, wishlist now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2197960/House_of_Jigsaw_Masters_of_Art/

notes.title: Great Jigsaw Game release Puzzle Pieces 5 Fairy Ring today!
notes.notes:
We are happy and proud to announce that Puzzle Pieces 5 Fairy Ring, the single player Jigsaw Game, will be released on Steam on November 24th 2022. 
 
[url=https://youtu.be/Fjnkz2hiOoc]WATCH THE TRAILER [/url]
 
After the great success on the Casual Game portals, we are sure you are going to like this latest release! 
 
[i]Go on a Wonderful Jigsaw Journey and earn Mana to reveal a Magical World. Enjoy this interesting puzzle images in this fairy adventure. Play 7 chapters with more than 250 HD levels. This game is 100% perfection, attention is paid to every detail, best in class. Enjoy! [/i]
 
Please visit the STEAM page of Puzzle Pieces 5 Fairy Ring today  and start playing this great Jigsaw game, have fun!
 
Cheers! 
 
Denda Games
